crossRefs.note: Your bars will be iron and bronze. As your days, so your strength will be.
and spoke to them, saying, “Return with much wealth to your tents, with very much livestock, with silver, with gold…
Now, behold, in my affliction I have prepared for Yahweh’s house one hundred thousand talents of gold, one million…
Iron is taken out of the earth, and copper is smelted out of the ore.

translations.web: a land in which you shall eat bread without scarcity, you shall not lack anything in it; a land whose stones are iron, and out of whose hills you may dig copper.
translations.bsb: a land where you will eat food without scarcity, where you will lack nothing; a land whose rocks are iron and whose hills are ready to be mined for copper.
translations.kjv: A land wherein thou shalt eat bread without scarceness, thou shalt not lack any thing in it; a land whose stones are iron, and out of whose hills thou mayest dig brass.
translations.asv: a land wherein thou shalt eat bread without scarceness, thou shalt not lack anything in it; a land whose stones are iron, and out of whose hills thou mayest dig copper.
